5.question: Why are my bean plants all leaves and no beans?
5.answer: This is a common issue caused by too much nitrogen in the soil. Beans are legumes and can fix their own nitrogen. Using a high-nitrogen fertilizer will encourage lush foliage at the expense of bean production.

15.question: When is the best time to plant peas?
15.answer: Peas are a cool-season crop. They should be planted as soon as the soil can be worked in the early spring. They can also be planted in late summer for a fall harvest.
